==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
Ashley and I are at an academy. We are trying to escape. The area seems to be surrounded by a force field. The scientists inside the academy have little, purple, robot spiders that are meant to warp our minds. The spiders don't seem to work on me. I use my immunity to help protect her.

The spirit of a woman named Astraya seems to be responsible for our captivity. When she reveals herself, I realize that the world is imaginary. I summon unstoppable gorillas to fight for us, but shortly afterwards I wake up.
